items.title: Photographer Sues Artist for Turning His Photo of British Rock Band Oasis Into $2 Million Painting
items.summary: A music photographer has sued an artist for turning his photo of British rock group Oasis into a painting, which sold for almost $2 million. [Read More]

items.title: Photographer Linda McCartney Celebrated With USPS Stamp Collection
items.summary: Photographer Linda McCartney will be honored by the United States Postal Service (USPS) with a series of postage stamps featuring her nature and still life photography. [Read More]

items.title: UK’s Rarest Bird Nests Kept Secret to Keep Wildlife Photographers Away
items.summary: The UK’s rarest bird of prey has successfully bred in a secret location for a second consecutive year to keep wildlife photographers away. [Read More]
